meta.summary: AI spend policy for a scaling ai_native seed startup with envelopes set at 2.0x sector median, governing 5 teams under a $20,000 monthly company envelope.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are reimbursable up to $50/month per employee only when the tool has no equivalent on the approved allowlist and the employee submits a use-case note within 7 days of purchase.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn reaches 90% before month end
Team envelope burn exceeds 100% or company envelope reaches 95%
Company envelope burn exceeds 110% or any agent kill threshold breached

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $1,000/month Support envelope and is correctly tagged to a customer-facing service, classifying as COGS under the production project-tag rule.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38 falls well within the $2,500/month Data envelope and requires no action; routine pass under standard OpEx classification.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 60% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely cause is a model-version or prompt-size regression introduced in the deploy, flagged for Engineering lead review.
rationales.e4: Subscription 3 for Marketing against a 5 subscription threshold. Approved.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 15000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: 340 retries at 47 per hour, over the 50 retry limit. About 1090 in overnight burn prevented. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is self-serve eligible under the 168-hour window with a $1,000 max delta cap; the request is approved provided incremental cost stays within that cap.
rationales.e8: Junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers ladder step 2 throttle; the unattributed spend is paused pending tag assignment, preserving the experimentation carve-out once the project is identified and tagged.
rationales.e9: Procurement agent dataset license purchase of $499 falls within the $600 single-transaction ceiling and the data-licensing merchant scope on the agent card; transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video tool at $89/month overlaps with the Sales team tool at $1,400/year running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value and the new trial subscription is rerouted.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to allow_with_review. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling is reclassified from COGS to OpEx under the internal-tooling project-tag rule; no financial restatement required if caught within the same accounting period.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
